about.title: About
about.subtitle: About Agubi Men's Health
about.lead: Agubi Men's Health is an evidence-based resource for men navigating prostate conditions — symptoms, diagnosis, treatment, and recovery. The site exists because the internet is full of either cold clinical jargon or vague wellness marketing, and very little in between.
about.whatWeCoverBody: Articles are organized around the conditions men actually encounter: prostatitis (including the four NIH categories), benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH), prostate cancer, prostate stones, and prostate cysts. Alongside the conditions themselves, there is a dedicated section on symptoms — what each symptom pattern tends to mean and how to describe it clearly to a clinician — and a treatment and recovery section for daily habits, medications, procedures, and lifestyle changes that are supported by current evidence.
about.whoItsForBody: Men who have just been diagnosed and want a calm second opinion. Men with chronic symptoms who want to understand what is actually happening. Partners and family members trying to support someone through a urology workup. Clinicians looking for a clear reference to share with patients.
about.howItsWrittenBody: Every article is grounded in current medical literature — guidelines from the American Urological Association and the European Association of Urology, peer-reviewed reviews, validated symptom scores such as the NIH-CPSI and IPSS, and patient-facing material from sources like the Mayo Clinic, Cleveland Clinic, and Prostate Cancer UK. Sources are listed at the end of each piece.
about.whatThisIsNotBody: Agubi Men's Health is not a substitute for medical advice, and nothing on the site should be used to diagnose or treat a condition. It is a starting point — a way to walk into a urology appointment more informed, not a way to skip one.
about.languagesBody: Articles are written in English, with translations into Simplified Chinese and Japanese. Coverage may vary slightly between languages as new articles are added.
about.contactIntro: Questions, corrections, or topic suggestions are welcome.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy matters. This page explains what information Agubi Men's Health collects, how it is used, and what choices you have. The short version: this site collects very little, does not run advertising trackers, and lets you delete anything you have submitted.
privacy.dataCollectedBody: Agubi Men's Health itself does not collect personal information beyond what is needed to deliver the page you requested. When you visit the site, our hosting provider (Cloudflare Pages) processes standard server logs (IP address, user agent, timestamp) for security and abuse prevention. These logs are retained by Cloudflare according to their standard practices and are not used by Agubi Men's Health to identify or contact individual visitors.
privacy.commentsBody: If you choose to leave a comment on an article, the only information stored is the display name you submit, the comment text you submit, a hash of your IP address (used only for spam rate-limiting), and the timestamp of submission. Comments are held in a moderation queue and are not visible publicly until reviewed and approved by an editor. You may request deletion of your comment at any time by contacting us using the address on the About page — please include the comment text so we can identify it.
privacy.cookiesBody: This site does not set tracking cookies of its own. Third-party services embedded in articles (for example, a YouTube video or an analytics snippet) may set their own cookies when you interact with them. Details are on the Cookies page.
privacy.rightsBody: If you have left a comment or otherwise provided information to this site, you can request to view, correct, or delete that data. Use the contact address on the About page. We will respond within thirty days.
privacy.childrenBody: This site is written for an adult audience and is not directed at children under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has submitted a comment, contact us and we will remove it.
privacy.changesBody: If this policy is updated, the date at the top of the page will change. Material changes will be noted in the next site update. Continued use of the site after an update indicates acceptance of the revised policy.

cookies.title: Cookies Policy
cookies.intro: This page explains what cookies are, which cookies Agubi Men's Health uses, and how you can control them. The short version: the site itself uses one optional cookie to remember your cookie-consent choice. Anything else comes from third-party services embedded in articles.
cookies.whatBody: Cookies are small text files that a website asks your browser to store, then reads back on later visits. They are widely used to remember preferences, keep you signed in, and measure site usage. Modern privacy regulations require sites to be transparent about which cookies they use and why.
cookies.useBody: Agubi Men's Health itself sets one cookie: a consent-preference cookie that remembers whether you have acknowledged the cookie banner, so it does not reappear on every page. It contains no personal data and expires after thirty days. No analytics, advertising, or cross-site tracking cookies are set by this site.
cookies.thirdPartyBody: When an article embeds content from another service — for example, a YouTube video, a Vimeo clip, or a tweet — those services may set their own cookies when you load or interact with the embed. Agubi Men's Health does not control those cookies. Their use is governed by the privacy policies of the respective services.
cookies.controlBody: Most browsers let you block or delete cookies through their settings. You can usually find these options under Privacy, History, or Site Data. Blocking all cookies can break parts of some sites; blocking only third-party cookies is often a good middle ground. You can also use private or incognito mode to visit the site without persisting any cookies at all.
cookies.changesBody: If the cookies used by this site change, this page will be updated and the date at the top will change.

disclosure.title: Affiliate Disclosure
disclosure.intro: In accordance with guidelines from the U.S. Federal Trade Commission and equivalent consumer protection rules in other jurisdictions, this page explains how Agubi Men's Health uses affiliate links and how the site is funded.
disclosure.whatBody: An affiliate link is a special URL that lets a retailer track referrals from this site. If you click an affiliate link and then make a purchase, the retailer pays Agubi Men's Health a small commission at no extra cost to you. Affiliate links never change the price you pay, and you would reach the same product page whether you used our link or went directly to the retailer.
disclosure.programsBody: Agubi Men's Health may participate in affiliate programs such as Amazon Associates, ShareASale, Impact, and others. The full list of programs is updated as new partnerships are added. Where a link is an affiliate link, the article will normally mention it.
disclosure.fundedBody: Agubi Men's Health is currently funded by the operator's own time and, when applicable, by affiliate commissions and small donations. The site does not display advertising, sell user data, or accept payment for editorial coverage of any product, brand, or service. Editorial decisions are made independently of any affiliate relationship.
disclosure.medicalBody: Agubi Men's Health covers medical and health topics. Nothing on this site is influenced by any commercial relationship. A product mentioned in an article is mentioned because it is relevant to the topic, not because the site has an affiliate arrangement with its maker. Sponsored content, if it ever appears, will be clearly labeled as such.
disclosure.changesBody: If this disclosure is updated, the date at the top of the page will change.
